items.title: AWS Parallel Computing Service now supports Split Cost Allocation Data
items.summary: Starting today, customers can receive granular cost visibility for AWS Parallel Computing Service (AWS PCS) in the AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), enabling you to analyze, optimize, and chargeback costs for your Slurm jobs. With AWS Split Cost Allocation Data for AWS PCS, customers can now allocate costs to individual teams and projects based on how jobs request and consume shared EC2 CPU, GPU, and memory resources.
